ctaSpec.userStory: As a user, I want to create a new training plan so that I can start preparing for my race.
As a user, I want to edit my plan details so that I can adjust my goals or schedule.
ctaSpec.ixdNotes: Opens a modal with editable plan fields.
ctaSpec.location: Top right of Plan Detail page

ctaSpec.userStory: As a user, I want to pause my plan so that I can take a break without falling behind.
ctaSpec.ixdNotes: Toggles status to 'Paused'. Stops sending notifications.

ctaSpec.userStory: As a user, I want to archive completed plans so that my active list stays clean.
ctaSpec.ixdNotes: Moves plan to 'Archived' tab. Read-only mode.

ctaSpec.userStory: As a user, I want to delete a plan I created by mistake so that it doesn't clutter my account.
As a user, I want to share my plan with a friend or coach so they can see my progress.
ctaSpec.ixdNotes: Generates a shareable link or image summary.
ctaSpec.location: Top right of Plan Detail page

ctas.name: Log Period Start
ctas.description: Log the start of a period

ctaSpec.userStory: As a user, I want to log when my period starts so that the app can predict my cycle phases accurately.
ctaSpec.ixdNotes: Opens date picker. Defaults to today.

ctaSpec.userStory: As a user, I want to log my symptoms so that I can track how I feel during different phases.
As a user, I want to manually adjust phase dates if the prediction is off so that my training aligns with my actual physiology.
As a user, I want to learn more about my current phase so that I can optimize my nutrition and recovery.

other.conditionalLogic: Affects display of all distance fields

ctaSpec.userStory: As a user, I want to update my profile information so that my training plan is based on my current stats.
As a user, I want to log a new PR so that my training paces can be adjusted.
As a user, I want to toggle between miles and kilometers so that I can see data in my preferred format.
As a user, I want to delete my account so that my data is removed from the system.
ctaSpec.ixdNotes: Requires double confirmation and password re-entry.

ctaSpec.userStory: As a user, I want to mark a session as complete so that I can track my progress.
ctaSpec.ixdNotes: Toggles status to 'Completed'. Updates progress bar.

ctaSpec.userStory: As a user, I want to skip a session if I'm sick or busy so that the app knows I didn't do it.
As a user, I want to adjust a session's distance or intensity if I need to modify the plan.
As a user, I want to add notes about how I felt so that I can look back on my training.

ctaSpec.userStory: As a user, I want to add a race to my calendar so that I can build a training plan around it.
As a user, I want to update my race goal if my training is going better or worse than expected.
As a user, I want to log my finish time after the race so that I can close out the training cycle.
ctaSpec.ixdNotes: Opens result form. Marks race as completed.
